resources.string: Offline Mode — Showing cached catalog. Release status may not reflect latest updates.

Third-party APKs are independently distributed via GitHub Releases and have not necessarily been reviewed by Google Play. SHA-256 verifies file integrity against the catalog checksum; it does not prove an APK is malware-free.
Android requires your permission before My Store can hand off a verified APK to the official system package installer. You will always confirm every install or update.
